purpose: Hands over a floral artwork. The art is the face; the hands exist to stay legible over it, not to decorate it.

night.recipe: Ignores night: a legacy exempt face; the artwork has no night variant until one is drawn.

options.intent: The hand colour; pick for contrast against the artwork, never to match it.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not add ticks or numerals over the artwork
antiPatterns.why: the art carries the composition and marks fight it
